_readme: The one sound-effect vocabulary for every style. Files live in assets/sfx (named copies from the Motionix pack in assets/sound-effects; see assets/sfx/SOURCES.md). peak = seconds from file start to its loudest point: the sound is started that much early so the hit lands on the motion. volume = linear gain under speech (0.08-0.35). Defaults come from the split-screen engine, used on 37 past jobs (1,605 sounds, about 41 per minute; tick and pop were 50% of them). Place sounds with: node studio/sfx.mjs place <in.mp4> <cues.json> <out.mp4>

tick.use: a list row lights up, a word or chip types in, a grid cell fills, a counter steps

pop.use: a card, chip, image or sticker appears

click.use: a button press, a selection, a cursor click

digital.use: a notification or toast lands, a phone screen changes

enter.use: a confirm: a tick mark, a search submitted, a step completed

open.use: a panel, app window or document opens

stretch.use: a line or graph draws, an underline sweeps, a bar grows

glitch.use: something is struck out, fails, turns red, or a wrong answer flashes

stamp.use: a verdict badge, stamp or tier lock slams on

shutter.use: a screenshot, photo or proof image is captured or flashed

hit.use: a big word or number slams in, a title card lands

money2.use: coins drop, money counter jumps (lighter than money)

gear.use: a system, machine or process starts turning

gear-tick.use: one mechanical step: a dial clicks, a part locks in

data.use: data loading, analytics filling, a dashboard populating

data-short.use: a quick data blip: results appear, a stat refreshes

stopwatch.use: time passing, a countdown, days ticking by (use sparingly)

riser.use: build-up that ends on a reveal or payoff

riser-short.use: a short lift into a reveal

whoosh-simple.use: light cut or slide, into or out of the presenter

whoosh-high.use: fast, bright cut or a card flying in

whoosh-low.use: heavy cut into a serious beat

whoosh-data.use: cut into a data, chart or UI scene

whoosh-flash.use: a flash-cut transition, a quick swipe or a white flash between scenes (SFX 01)

riser-metal.use: a tense, metallic build into a dramatic reveal; harder than riser (SFX 01; the file is loud, keep the volume low)

counting.use: a number counting up or down on screen, a stat ticking to its value (SFX 01; trim to the count's length)

scroll.use: scrolling a list, carousel or feed, a dial or wheel turning (SFX 01; quiet file, full volume is right)

iphone-ding.use: a phone notification or text message pops up (SFX 01)

keyboard.use: typing on screen: a search bar, a message, a prompt being written (SFX 01; starts on `at`, the moment typing starts; set `dur` to the typing's length)

mouse-click.use: a cursor clicks a button or link on a screen recording or UI (SFX 01)

lens-focus.use: a punch-in or zoom, a focus pull, spotlighting one thing (SFX 01)

flash-charge.use: the build before a photo or proof flash; pair with shutter at the flash (SFX 01)

rubber-stretch.use: something stretches, bends or snaps back, a playful elastic move (SFX 01)

water-stream.use: flow through a pipe or funnel

water-pour.use: pouring into a bucket or tank

logo-sting.use: a logo or brand mark resolves at the end; a payoff title lands

riser-build.use: a measured build into a reveal; set --dur to the gap before the reveal

shutter-quick.use: a fast camera shutter on a screenshot or proof flash

ui-glass-shatter.use: a UI card, board or screen shatters like glass (crack + falling glassy shards; no explosion). Built 2026-11-07 from CC0 sounds: uisfx glass/snap + glass/delete, SFX Library glassy ticks SFX-0813/SFX-0857 (no crackle: Bryan didn't like the noisy shatter)

ui-open.use: a card, panel or graphic appears (uisfx Studio kit, CC0: one matching UI family; Bryan 2026-11-07: UI sounds, not low impact taps, not beeps)

ui-select.use: a small word, chip or option appears or is picked (uisfx Studio kit, CC0: one matching UI family; Bryan 2026-11-07: UI sounds, not low impact taps, not beeps)

ui-progress-step.use: a list row, step or tracker advances (uisfx Studio kit, CC0: one matching UI family; Bryan 2026-11-07: UI sounds, not low impact taps, not beeps)

ui-press.use: a button press or tap on screen (uisfx Studio kit, CC0: one matching UI family; Bryan 2026-11-07: UI sounds, not low impact taps, not beeps)

ui-expand.use: a big word or panel grows in (uisfx Studio kit, CC0: one matching UI family; Bryan 2026-11-07: UI sounds, not low impact taps, not beeps)

ui-swipe.use: a full-screen graphic slides in (uisfx Studio kit, CC0: one matching UI family; Bryan 2026-11-07: UI sounds, not low impact taps, not beeps)

ui-back.use: the full-screen graphic leaves, back to the speaker (uisfx Studio kit, CC0: one matching UI family; Bryan 2026-11-07: UI sounds, not low impact taps, not beeps)

ui-success.use: a goal reached, a deal won (uisfx Studio kit, CC0: one matching UI family; Bryan 2026-11-07: UI sounds, not low impact taps, not beeps)

ui-focus.use: a word or element comes into focus (uisfx Studio kit, CC0)

_library_readme: The full Motionix pack (74 sounds in 9 folders) is in assets/sound-effects. To use a sound that has no cue name yet, copy it into assets/sfx with a short name, measure its peak (node studio/sfx.mjs peak <file>), and add it here.
